clean_note: clean=true describes the state AFTER this lane's single clean commit; A1 verifies with git status --porcelain=v1 (must be empty) and git diff --check HEAD^ HEAD (must be clean).
deliverables: Central V3 scored runner research/assets/forex_free_v3/scored_runner.py, adapted from the proven V2 architecture (family arm APIs -> runner books everything -> frozen gates -> once-only publish), now booking exclusively through the V3 P1 kernel (research/assets/forex_free_v3/accounting.py). The full FAMILY API CONTRACT is documented in the module docstring so the A5/A6 implementation lanes implement against it without reading runner internals: run_arm(arm, data_paths, macro_reader, freeze_token) -> {decisions, financing_events, meta}; decisions carry decision_id/pair/decision_ts/side/notional_usd/entry_bar_ts/entry_price/exit_bar_ts/exit_price/force_flat; financing_events carry {decision_id, financing_adjustment_usd, formula} which the runner carries, sums and digests but NEVER computes; meta declares decision_clock ('daily' enforced), usd_index_daily_returns, fill_delay_events, incremental_alpha, proposal_id.

V3 DELTA decision clock: runner consumes DECISION EVENTS at daily-or-slower granularity and fails closed (DecisionRuleError codes) on DECISION_CLOCK_VIOLATION (decision/fill instants must be completed 16:00 America/New_York daily bars via zoneinfo), ONE_EVENT_LAG_VIOLATION (fill must be strictly after the decision instant and within 4 days: Friday decisions fill Monday, same-bar fills forbidden), CLOCK_UNSUPPORTED (only declared 'daily' passes).

V3 DELTA fold force-flat: FOLD_FORCE_FLAT_VIOLATION on any trade spanning an internal fold boundary (2022-05-01 / 2024-07-01); force-flat trades closed at the boundary's last NY bar attribute cleanly to the entry fold; folds/purge (14d) inherited unchanged from V2 w2_freeze per baseline_invariants.json.

V3 DELTA dual book: every cell record carries price_only_pnl_usd AND financing_adjusted_pnl_usd as separate digest-covered kernel columns (book_dual); dry-run zeroes both as placeholders (scored=false, real_pnl=false); test pins digest + validate_scored_record DUAL_BOOK_VIOLATION on mutation.

V3 DELTA stress: F1-FIXED book_stress over the frozen ladder {1.0, 1.5, 2.0} with tier multipliers applied to BOOKED stress PnL and pairwise-distinct rows certified by the kernel; the frozen one-event delay (fill_delay_events) is carried UNBLENDED (delay_stress.carried_unblended=true, V3-L2); hand-computed tier nets 451.5454545455/450.0454545455/448.5454545455 with pure cost deltas -1.5/-3.0.
V3 DELTA break-even: break_even_cost_bps recorded per cell from the kernel (break_even_bps over gross price PnLs).

V3 DELTA financing gate: FINANCING_MANUFACTURES_EDGE fires when the financing-adjusted anchor expectancy is positive while the price-only expectancy is non-positive (financing must not manufacture the edge, PLAN section 12).

V3 DELTA timeout: 60-minute wall per arm (config, resource_contract) enforced by call_family_arm; timeout raises TechAbort and the exec driver takes the fail-closed TECHABORT path (run stops, nothing further booked/published, report records TECHABORT_TIMEOUT, exit 3).

V3 DELTA macro reader: research/assets/forex_free_v3/macro_reader.py wraps the P0 pit.select_asof core; PolicyRateReader.policy_rate(area, decision_ts)/differential(base, quote, ts) are availability-gated (available_time_utc <= T, effective semantics) and fail closed with MacroDataBlocked (BLOCKED_DATA) on missing vintage files/areas; no eligible vintage at T returns None (NO_EVAL, never backfilled); vintage JSON files are NormalizedRecord canonical payloads.

Gates enforced (stage_a_gates, frozen ex ante from baseline_invariants.json): EXPECTANCY_NONPOSITIVE (financing-adjusted), FINANCING_MANUFACTURES_EDGE, PF_BELOW_1.10, INCREMENTAL_ALPHA_NOT_POSITIVE (when meta supplies it), DECISION_FLOOR_NOT_MET (<40 decisions), FEWER_THAN_2_POSITIVE_POPULATED_FOLDS, POPULATED_FOLD_PF_BELOW_0.80, MDD_ABOVE_FROZEN_CEILING (2500 USD), POSITIVE_FOLD_SHARE_ABOVE_50PCT, PAIR_CONCENTRATION_ABOVE_40PCT, STRESS_EMPTY_TRADE_SET / STRESS_TIER_x_FAIL (pnl>0, PF>=1.0), DROP_ONE_PAIR_SURVIVAL_INSUFFICIENT (<5 of 7), USD_DRIFT_EXPLAINS_ANCHOR (|corr|>0.3 over >=60 days, runner-owned statistic over the frozen D1 index series). mechanism_sanity carries NEIGHBOUR_DOES_NOT_SUPPORT_ANCHOR and CONTROL_REPRODUCES_MECHANISM.

Publication: once-only, digest-addressed, behind a freeze token (FOREX_FREE_V3_W3): publish_cell requires an authorization file {freeze_token: ...} (LAUNCH_AUTHORIZATION_MISSING / FREEZE_TOKEN_MISMATCH), refuses dry-run records (REAL_PNL_REQUIRED_FOR_SCORED_PUBLICATION), computes gates into the payload and delegates to the kernel ScoredLedgerPublisher (published flipped true pre-digest, flock once-only, replay = zero delta).

exec_driver.py: serial per-family anchor->neighbour->control loop, --family family_id=module.path registry, modes dummy/scored, TECHABORT fail-closed path, forex_free_v3_exec_report_v1. Smoke-tested in dummy mode (exit 0, 3 cells + MECHANISM_SANITY).

Test suite tests/assets/forex_free_v3/test_scored_runner.py: 40 tests mirroring the 17 V2 runner tests adapted to V3 plus the required V3 additions (dummy end-to-end dry-run, once-only publish, dual-book presence+immutability, F1-fixed distinct stress rows, financing gate on a synthetic manufactured case, fold force-flat attribution, one-event-lag/clock rejections, USD-drift diag hand case, TECHABORT timeout, macro-reader gating/BLOCKED_DATA).
